data.one_liner: Clipboard manager with text, HTML, and image support across Android, iOS, Web, and Windows.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to copy and paste text, rich text (HTML), and PNG images. It also offers clipboard monitoring, utility methods, and robust error handling.
use_when: Need to copy or paste rich text or images in a Flutter app
Want a single package that works on mobile, web, and desktop
avoid_when: Only basic text clipboard is required
You already use a platform‑specific clipboard solution
weaknesses: No support for file paths or custom binary formats beyond image
